While I very much share your concerns, a few fundamental flaws exist with this idea:

Downvoat Brigading:

Concerted downvoat brigade efforts are a serious problem around here - being on the recieving end of that myself, I can very much see how would-be brigaders would jump on the opportunity to bury users who they deem to be a threat. Downvoat brigading could very easily lead to genuine posters being sunk well below -50 ccp.

CCP Farming:

Due to the possibility of being downvoated into purgatory, the idea proposed would actually encourage CCP farming(whether in v/pizzagate or elsewhere) by shills who know they're likely to drop below the cut-off. That aside, if a genuine user is downvoated below cut-off, how exactly are they meant to recover without CCP farming in other subverses - especially if brigading is responsible in the first place?

Alt accounts:

Those users will then be banned from posting under any alt account in order to prevent circumventing the rules.

This is a 2-fold problem, not only can alt accounts be used to offset downvoat/upvoat counts(making it harder for genuine users to hinder shills & easier for shills to hinder genuine users), but, how can it be proven that any one account is an alt of another, under control of the same person? Sure, behavioral patterns stand out, but, mimicry/copycats exist also; autonomous banning of alts is very difficult to achieve in a way that isn't subject to human error - keeping in mind that vpn's and proxy sites can be used to mask the ip in-use by 2+ accounts operated from the same machine/location.

For the record: I don't mean to seem like I'm totally shitting on your concerns/ideas, just that many opporunities exist for this idea to be exploited/abused/undermined.
